title: Plugin Manifest Schema
description: Defines the structure of an Athena OS Genre or Capability Plugin.

services_provided.description: List of Service IDs (SRV-xxx) this plugin injects into the Service Registry

domains_injected.description: List of Knowledge Domains (e.g., DOM-Cyberware) this plugin adds

qa_rules.description: Specific QA checklist items that override or add to standard QA
